proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Rule VII, Section 706, what are the TWO conditions that must be satisfied before a building may qualify for a floor area increase?

options.text: Installation of a full NFPA 13 sprinkler system AND approval of the Building Official, provided that the system covers all floors and areas
Public space, streets, or yards adjoining at least one side of the building AND Building Official approval, contingent upon compliance with local zoning ordinances
Public space, streets, or yards extending along and adjoining two or more sides of the building AND subject to Building Official approval
A corner lot location AND a minimum FLAR of 3.0, which must be verified by a licensed surveyor

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Option B is a common trap — 'one side' is insufficient. The provision requires 'two or more sides.' Option A misleads by suggesting sprinklers are an explicit standalone trigger — they are considered via Building Official discretion but are not an enumerated requirement in Sec. 706 itself. Option D introduces a FLAR threshold not found in the code text.
